notes:
This update covers everything since 1.40.8.

The bot now installs with OPTiC. OPTiCBot.exe used to be a separate download; it is inside the installer now, which is why this one is larger. Report sweeps and the headless tools find it on their own.

Uninstalling quietly no longer deletes your data. An unattended uninstall used to answer the “remove your saved data as well?” question yes on your behalf, taking the database, every saved bot login and all backups with it.

The database now folds its write-ahead journal back on a schedule and on exit — the best protection there is against the file damage a force-close can cause.

Licence changes take effect immediately instead of waiting out a ten-minute cache, and an unreachable licence server no longer makes the app feel frozen.

Bots launch in the order you arranged them. Launching ignored your labels and went through one flat list, so a label dragged to the bottom could start first and a single label could be split across the run. The Start button also responds immediately, and any bot that fails to start is tried once more.

Live City Scripts is open to everyone, badged IN TESTING.

Restore goals from a backup you choose, goals backup scoped to your own accounts, “never use a proxy” honoured properly, hidden groups, one city across every account, and rewritten setup instructions with a self-check.

Plus hardening across every database read behind the tables.
